The auditors are now expected on site **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17** at the Austin office, but the sources disagree.

- On Nov 16, the Ardent QSA asked to move the on-site from the week of Dec 7 to Dec 15–17. He said the second assessor had a conflict. Shira Ben-Ami replied that Dec 15–17 works, and he said updated invites would follow. [3]
- The original dates were Dec 8–10. [4]
- The evidence package is still due Dec 1. [3]
- Avi Kessler posted in #compliance on Nov 17, a day after the change, that the auditors are on site Dec 8–10. He asked people to book flights by the end of the week. [2] That looks like the old dates, since it came after Shira accepted the move. I didn't find anything that cancels the Dec 15–17 change.

Before you book, confirm with Shira or Avi. The Dec 15–17 dates also run into the TLV holiday party on Dec 17, if that matters for your travel. [5]
